heading: About Us
title: About PJS Consultant Firm
description: Established in 2016, PJS Consultant Firm (PJS Engineering Construction & Consultant Firm) is a trusted name in Bangladesh's construction and consultancy sector. Based in Faridpur, we specialize in architectural and structural design, real estate consultancy, and complete construction solutions. With a team of expert engineers, architects, and technicians, we deliver innovative, reliable, and efficient services tailored to each client’s vision. From soil testing to city plan approvals—our all-in-one solution ensures your dream project becomes reality with quality and professionalism at its core.
